rec.name: Exciting Content Elements (Animated Counter Stats Section)
rec.status: Built — launched (client feedback applied; documentation and product image still pending)

what.text: A reusable full-width Shopify section that shows a headline, a subheadline and 2–4 stat boxes side by side. Each box has a large number (e.g. "22", "99+", "88"), a short uppercase category label (e.g. HEADPHONE, BLUETOOTH, SPEAKER) and a short description. Thin dividers separate the boxes. On desktop an optional hand-drawn sparkle/star icon is placed over the top-left of the grid and animates in (line-drawing effect). Variant 1 of two; Variant 2 is a separate ticket.

why.text: Large, scannable numbers quickly communicate scale, range or proof (selection size, number of offers, years, customers). Concrete figures are more credible than vague claims. A counter that animates as the section scrolls into view draws attention and makes the facts easier to remember. The hand-drawn icon adds a friendly, distinctive touch that breaks up the page and keeps visitors scrolling.

how.text: Create the section file ed-cro-exciting-content-elements.liquid, paste in the provided code and add it via the theme editor (Global / any template). Blocks: Heading Title (with optional highlighted word and underline SVG), Heading Content (subheadline rich text), and repeatable Content Element blocks (number, label, description). CSS custom properties drive the settings. Layout is a CSS grid: 1 column on mobile, and on screens of 1000px or wider N columns (default 3) with vertical border lines between items. The count-up animation uses the native IntersectionObserver (no third-party libraries). The JS is wrapped in an IIFE so the section can be added several times on one page without conflicts. The draw icon is an absolutely positioned inline SVG with stroke-dashoffset animation. It is hidden below 1000px.

items: Heading Title block: text, highlighted word with underline SVG, custom font family, font size (desktop and mobile), line height, letter spacing, text transform, alignment (desktop and mobile), custom max width, top and bottom spacing, colour
Heading Content block (subheadline): rich text, font family, size, line height, letter spacing, alignment (desktop and mobile), max width, spacing, colour
Content Element blocks: number/value, category label, short description
Items per row (2–4 on desktop; single column on mobile)
Show border toggle and border colour (e.g. #E5E5E5)
Counter (number) size, heading size and content size – separate desktop and mobile values
Show Draw-icon toggle, Draw-icon size (e.g. 130px), Draw-icon Left (%) and Draw-icon Top (%) position – added after client feedback; hidden on mobile
Section background colour and text colour
Top and bottom spacing (desktop and mobile)

Optional CTA button (text, link, round/square style, alignment) and optional icon/emoji per box were listed in the acceptance criteria; they are not visible in the screenshots or the provided code excerpt

dependencies.text: Shopify theme "Yuva" (uses its .container class, h2 class and global settings.heading_color, settings.text_color and settings.background). No apps or metafields needed; all content is entered in the theme editor. Custom fonts use Shopify's font_picker and font_url filter. Native IntersectionObserver only; no external JS library. The code file was truncated in the source, so the counter JS and schema were not fully visible.

items: Engagement with the section (CTA clicks, if the CTA is enabled)
Conversion rate of the page containing the section
Add-to-cart rate and click-through to collections or products (if linked)
